free_tier.stated: 10 MiB per uploaded image, animated GIFs 2 MiB; images over 2 MiB are resized below 2 MiB; no per-account total is stated on the page read

per_object_cap.stated: 10 MiB hard cap per upload (file or URL); images over 2 MiB are resized below 2 MiB; animated GIFs stay capped at 2 MiB

retention.stated: Images over 2 MiB are automatically resized below 2 MiB, so stored bytes differ from the upload; historical Imgur images were migrated to i.sstatic.net (migration complete 2024-05-28).

egress.terms: free, Cloudflare-fronted, cacheable — probe showed 'Server: cloudflare', 'cf-cache-status: HIT'

tooling: no official image-upload endpoint in the SE API; images are inserted by the web editor or by POSTing a post body containing an already-hosted URL. Wrapper only (Selenium/editor automation) — this is the failure point
chaining: 2 MiB x unlimited posts x unlimited answers x N Stack Exchange sites (180+ sites, one network account). 500 GB = ~256,000 images; not a practical bulk store without a browser farm

limits.value: 10 MiB hard cap per upload (file or URL); animated GIFs 2 MiB

limits_note: 10 MiB hard cap per upload, images over 2 MiB are automatically resized below 2 MiB (best effort), animated GIFs capped at 2 MiB; not byte-exact storage; posting rate limits per site
reliability_note: the most permanent image host in this set — SE migrated every historical Imgur URL to i.sstatic.net in May 2024 precisely to guarantee links never rot; a live 2013-era test image still returns 200 with Last-Modified 2024-05-01
